items.title: Could HBF be the solution to the Memory bottleneck?
items.summary: Investing.com -- The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence workloads is creating a growing demand for memory capacity and bandwidth, opening the door for a new storage technology that could ease infrastructure constraints while providing a fresh growth opportunity for the NAND flash industry, Bernstein said.

items.title: SpaceX (SPCX) Lands $45 Billion AI Deal As New Contracts Recast Its Growth Story
items.summary: Space Exploration Technologies (NasdaqGS:SPCX) has secured a reported US$45b AI compute agreement from Anthropic for access to its Colossus and Colossus II data centers. items.title: What Is Meta Platforms (META) Facing As Legal Risks Rise And AI Deals Expand?
items.summary: Meta Platforms (NasdaqGS:META) joined Google and TikTok in suing California to block a new youth social media law targeting users under 16. Police in India registered a First Information Report against Meta after complaints over alleged child sexual abuse material on Instagram and Facebook. AMD disclosed agreements under which Meta may gain rights to about 320 million AMD shares as part of AI chip related deals. items.title: Why AI investors may favor established data-center owners
items.summary: James Demmert, chief investment officer at Main Street Research, sees value in AI but draws a sharp line between dominant operators with existing data centers and companies still racing to build them.

items.title: How sustainable is the AI investment boom after Thursday’s selloff?
items.summary: Investing.com -- The artificial intelligence investment boom is becoming increasingly difficult to sustain at its current pace as technology companies pour billions of dollars into infrastructure without a corresponding acceleration in revenues, raising the risk of an eventual spending slowdown that could weigh on economic growth, Capital Economics said.

items.title: Anthropic’s $895 Billion AI Gamble Could Become Wall Street’s Next Debt Nightmare
items.summary: Anthropic's IPO filing reveals a staggering web of contracts, and the companies on the other side are already burning cash to honor them. Six stocks have started to react, and only one is holding up.
